en: Black-and-white view along a tree‑lined promenade with benches and an ornate metal railing overlooking a large historic riverside palace in the background. A man in early 20th‑century attire, holding a cane and wearing a hat and suit, poses near a tree in the foreground. The palace has richly decorated façades, mansard roofs, and towers, and stands on a slope above a river valley.
